verdict.rationale: dlt has a purpose-built AI Harness (skills, rules, MCP servers) that teaches coding agents like Claude Code, Cursor, or Codex to build production-grade pipelines including auth, pagination, and streams from a REST API description, plus an OpenAPI-spec generator (dlt-init-openapi) that auto-generates connectors with pagination/auth handling for review before shipping. Docs explicitly describe agents building ingestion end-to-end and 'turning AI assistants into expert dlt pipeline developers across 11,200+ REST API sources.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of an agent actually drafting a connector from raw API docs end-to-end (only vendor docs, no community validation of this specific AI-drafting workflow).
